version.changelog: Strategy-live close/sell guard, defi_order_status terminal, execution_capabilities

llm.summary: This is a disclosed CAI/Hyperliquid trading helper with real financial risk but no hidden code, persistence, or unrelated data access in the inspected artifact.

dimensions.detail: External CAI URLs, hosted approval, and a CAI API key are proportionate to the stated CAI trading integration; no broad local file access or local indexing is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill and only documents setting a CAI API key with openclaw secrets; it contains no bundled executable code, package install, remote payload execution, or tool-wrapping behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to CAI Hyperliquid flows and named DeFi tools, with user enrollment through CAI-hosted approval; the artifact discloses platform or full API scope, but users should prefer the narrower platform scope when available.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill describes delegated agent authorization and a custodial EVM address for ongoing platform automation, which is expected for the trading purpose and disclosed; it does not install local persistence or claim withdrawal authority beyond the described protocol design.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to trade Hyperliquid perpetuals via CAI, and the listed capabilities for readiness, markets, preflight, placing, canceling, closing, and checking orders match that purpose; the financial impact is significant because it supports live perps trading and optional deposits.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let CAI help trade Hyperliquid perpetuals. Use platform scope instead of full scope when possible, understand that deposits and approveAgent authorization can enable live leveraged trading through a custodial workflow, and confirm order details before any live trade.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The advisory finding is supported as a disclosure gap: the artifact enables live perpetuals trading, optional deposit, custodial address use, and approveAgent authorization without a prominent loss/liquidation warning, but those behaviors are explicit and aligned with the skill purpose rather than hidden or unrelated.
